academy-seminar.text: Keep lecturer and cadets physically distributed around the volumetric model. Students should cross sightlines, point, step into sections of the projection and trade glances rather than sitting in static rows.

technical-demo.text: Anchor hands to real controls, connectors, slates and hardware. When a system state changes, show who caused it and who notices first.

dock-walk.text: Let conversation continue while the group moves among working crews and ships. Background personnel keep servicing equipment instead of stopping to watch the principals.

bridge-sim.text: Maintain stable station geography across the final exercise so navigation, engineering, BHA and command decisions are visually attributable.
